items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I used to play with him, you know. But we, we played for him at... Beansy Rampo... We, Fats, uh, Fats Pichon, we played at his place at the time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

He's playing too, you know. Who did he work with? He work by himself or what band? By himself. Sometimes we used to get him to play, I'd tell you he'd play sometimes, and I'd tell you about the grocery store and he'd be sick. But he didn't play with no regular band, you know, he used to play most by himself. Did I say Tony Jackson? Yeah. I'd say that. How about Pichon? Pichon? Hmm.
